papers.selection_reason: 2026 线性层结构优化竞争者；证明纯 AES MixColumn 深度 10 并不足以构成新纪录，仍需检查门数与系统效果。

evidence.support: 作者报告自动合成 AES MixColumn 深度 10，相对其引用的手工结果多两个 CNOT；尚未运行电路或审计最优性。

routes.name: Search and complete-oracle accounting
routes.question: How do a cipher circuit and classical transcript become a reproducibly costed successful key search?

leaders.criterion: Complete iteration and successful search resources
leaders.conditions: Same AES key size, pair count, M, success target, processor count, gate model and total-depth cap
leaders.reason: P03 is a strong reproduction starting point, but no complete-iteration ranking was verified; P14 remains abstract-level evidence. 2026-11-11 增补成本先例不改变此判断。

routes.name: Nonlinear synthesis
routes.question: Which S-box implementations give the best tradeoff after integration and cleanup?

leaders.criterion: T-depth, width and bounded NCT synthesis under their separate domains
leaders.conditions: Preserve in-place/out-of-place contract, ancilla and measurement rules; P09's Keccak result is not AES
leaders.reason: 新增 P21/P22 的 TDW/FDW 与复合域候选；仍无全局组件或完整 oracle 最优，定理域与具体分解需核查。

routes.name: Linear-layer synthesis and scheduling
routes.question: How much full depth can linear synthesis and compiler-aware scheduling save?

leaders.criterion: CNOT depth for AES MixColumns and linear subcircuits
leaders.conditions: Same binary map, no-ancilla/in-place contract, connectivity, relabeling and scheduler
leaders.reason: P28 新增循环结构自动合成；深度 10 已有多项作者报告，未在统一调度器下重建或证明最优。P04 的 2024-10 修订属于原核心近期窗，不属于本次滚动窗口。

routes.name: Round and key-schedule co-design
routes.question: Which joint schedule best trades peak workspace for encryption and oracle depth?

leaders.criterion: Separate low-width, low-depth and depth-width Pareto points
leaders.conditions: Coherent candidate-key schedule; match measurement/decomposition and cost boundary
leaders.reason: P06/P15 省略比较等成本，P21 有 forward-only 与 forward+adjoint 两类表，P22 的 102800 是加密侧指标；没有完成同口径排名。

routes.name: Cleanup, comparison and diffusion
routes.question: Can local cleanup and multi-control operations be optimized without losing the phase-oracle contract?

leaders.criterion: Oracle-aware scheduling and few-ancilla multi-control constructions
leaders.conditions: P15 computational-basis circuit transformation with unitary global reversal; P19 clean/dirty/conditionally clean distinctions and measurement accounting
leaders.reason: 未在共同约束下复现完整 AES phase oracle 加 diffuser；P23/P24/P26/P27 提供通用清理先例，不据此声称 AES 资源最优。

comparisons.task: 为资源优化选择有依据的目标
comparisons.metric: DW、限时攻击 D²W、存活体积与架构相关 active volume
comparisons.conditions: P03：固定成功率、内部分区并行与总深度限制；P23：辅助位存活时间；P25：非局域容错架构的逻辑操作块及 reaction depth；这些量不相互等同
